serviceIdentification.fedRampPackageId: Business Integra Technology Solutions, Inc. MODZ
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Moderniza converts legacy estates (COBOL, VB6, PHP, Java, .NET and others) into modern, tested, containerised applications through an evidence-driven pipeline of five steps: Blueprint, Contract, Code, Testing and Deploy. Every step leaves a ledger the customer can audit.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: FedRAMP Certification Data: offering profile, Key Security Indicators, historical snapshots, policies, vulnerability and ongoing certification reports.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Public certification data needs no account. Agency customers and assessors receive a read-only account with the compliance:read permission, which unlocks per-measurement evidence and historical snapshots through the same URLs.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: How to configure the offering securely.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Scans the uploaded legacy source (inventory, reading plan, business-rule extraction; unsafe files are quarantined) and produces the target architecture, epics, user stories and screen designs. Code generation does not start until the Blueprint is approved.
Defines the entities, APIs, business rules and screens the modern application must honor, built from the approved Blueprint and approved rules.
Splits the work into tasks and generates the application; accepted only after it builds, starts, answers API smoke tests, navigates correctly and passes its generated tests.
Runs the generated application, records every defect in an issue ledger and repairs it (Run & Fix), then produces the fidelity, maintainability and security code report.
Deploys the delivery into the customer's containers after the pre-deploy gates pass.
Review, editing and Drools export of the extracted business rules.
